messages:
Priya: quick sync — MerchantX pilot failing during SDK init in staging. Getting a 401 on the handshake when we request ephemeral creds. Customer is blocked, pilot kickoff tomorrow. Anyone seen this before?
Tom: can you paste the exact error from the agent?
Priya: paste from Node logs: `Error: handshake failed: 401 invalid_signature`
Priya: curl we tried: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sdks/init -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"env":"staging","client_id":"merchantx"}'```
Jordan: are they using short-lived creds via our presales connector or the test api-key?
Priya: using ephemeral via bridge (short-lived creds). They followed the runbook but I think the connector host header was wrong.
Devon: MerchantX is behind a mutual proxy. We saw similar where proxy rewrote Host header and signature mismatch. Ops-bot can you confirm if our bridge respects X-Forwarded-Host?
ops-bot: deployment note: bridge v0.9.3 preserves X-Forwarded-* by default; proxy rewrite can still break HMAC signature if Host changes.
Tom: if Host header mismatch, signature sig_base shouldn't match. Quick workaround: set SDK option `overrideHost: "bridge.internal"` in init to match signed value.
Priya: will try. Also, customer raised security items: they need KMS integration for key wrapping and SOC2 attestation doc. Do we have a packaged answer?
Devon: we have SOC2 + ISO certs in the compliance folder; for KMS we can support BYOK via our Private offering or use Cloud KMS for Dedicated. I'll DM the checklist.
Jordan: also note: if they go Private, the handshake uses short-lived certs instead of HMAC tokens. That avoids host-based signature issues.
Priya: pricing Q as well — MerchantX asked delta between hosted pilot vs Dedicated reserved for a month. Simple ballpark?
Devon: for a 1-month pilot with guaranteed baseline (2k qps bursts), presales discount typically 30% on reserved capacity. I'll ping Legal for the exact quote.
Tom: back to the 401 — if overriding host not possible, give them this snippet for env var workaround in the SDK: ```export REDWOOD_BRIDGE_HOST=bridge.internal && node start.js```
Priya: attempted overrideHost and now handshake moves forward but streaming init fails with `ERR: unsupported_protocol` when establishing SSE.
Jordan: what SDK version? older SDKs had TLS ALPN mismatch for SSE -> upgrade to 2.4.1.
Priya: they were on 2.3.0. Upgrading now.
Priya: upgrade fixed SSE. We still have two asks to close: 1) KMS/BYOK details for their security questionnaire, 2) a pilot pricing line item for Dedicated vs hosted.
Devon: I'll assemble a one-pager with KMS options + sample contract language, and prod a pricing sheet.
Priya: thanks — can we also offer a short architect call with MerchantX infra tomorrow 10am PT? They want to walk the SSO, IP allowlist, and callback URL flow for structured outputs + function call tooling.
Tom: I can join to cover streaming & function-call behaviors (latency, fallback).
Jordan: I'll join to demo SDK init and show the host override + ephemeral creds flow.
Devon: I'll prep the security artifacts and pricing. Priya, add calendar invite and attach the SOC2 + KMS notes.
Priya: invite sent. attaching runbook link in thread: https://redwood.com/docs/presales/runbooks/bridge-handshake
Tom: once this is done we should add a short FAQ for proxies rewriting Host headers — recurring presales snag.
Priya: agree — logging ticket to docs team. :memo:
Devon: :thumbsup: good job team, will update after call.
ops-bot: reminder: presales checkout checklist item #7 (certs uploaded) still open for MerchantX.
